crossRefs.note: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy…
When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…

translations.web: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
translations.bsb: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
translations.kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
translations.asv: The meek have seen it, and are glad: Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.
